title: 지하철 이용 어휘 (표 구매·개찰·환승·출구)
summary: This worksheet teaches 10 core Korean words for using the subway: buying tickets, passing the ticket gate, transferring, and finding exits. Each word has a short, practical example sentence.
objective: Learn 10 key subway vocabulary items (ticket purchase, ticket gate, transfer, exit) with short example sentences that you can use immediately.

task.title: Ask the station staff
task.line: Imagine you are lost in a station. Ask a 역무원 where to transfer and how to get to your exit, for example: '실례합니다. 2호선은 어디에서 갈아타요? 3번 출구는 어디예요?'

exercises: Write the Korean word for 'ticket machine'. (First sounds: ㅈㄷㅂㅁㄱ)
Write the Korean word for 'ticket (paper)'. (First sounds: ㅅㅊㄱ)
Fill in the blank: ___하는 곳이 어디예요? (Where is the place to transfer?)
Fill in the blank: 2번 ___로 나오세요. (Come out through exit 2.)
Fill in the blank: ___를 찍고 들어가요. (I tap my transport card and go in.)
Fill in the blank: ___를 지나서 들어가요. (Go in through the ticket gate.)
Fill in the blank: 여기에서 버스로 ___ 수 있어요? (Can I change to a bus here?)
Fill in the blank: 출구 번호는 ___에 있어요. (The exit number is on the information sign.)
Fill in the blank: 표를 잃어버렸어요. ___에게 말하세요. (I lost my ticket. Tell the station staff.)
Fill in the blank: 공항까지 ___로 가요. (I go to the airport by subway.)

words.exampleMeaning: Please tap your card at the gate.
I have my transport card ready.
I buy a ticket from the machine.
Please transfer at the next station.
